title: The Spark: one wrong turn that started World War I

segments.text: One wrong turn started World War One.
The heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne is riding through the city with his wife.
A bomb has already missed the archduke's car.
Soon after, his driver takes a wrong turn, and stops to reverse,
right in front of nineteen-year-old Gavrilo Princip.
Princip steps forward and fires twice.
Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie are dead within the hour.
Within six weeks, the great powers of Europe were at war.
It all began with a moment of confusion on a crowded street.
